groups.title: OBD-II / UDS, one request at a time
UDS conversation on a claimed bus

bindings.name: log
bindings.doc: Print a line to the run output and the device log. Numbers need str().

bindings.name: sleep_ms
bindings.doc: Pause for up to 60 000 ms. The run budget keeps counting while asleep.

bindings.name: uds
bindings.doc: One request to an ECU over ISO-TP with 11-bit CAN ids: OBD-II modes ('01 0C') and UDS services ('22 F1 90') alike. Sets uds_ok and uds_nrc; a negative response comes back as its hex ('7F 22 31').

bindings.name: uds_ext
bindings.doc: Same as uds() with 29-bit CAN ids.

bindings.name: uds_nrc_str
bindings.doc: The ISO 14229 name of a negative response code, e.g. 0x31 -> requestOutOfRange.

bindings.name: obd_claim
bindings.doc: Hold the bus for a multi-step conversation with one ECU; the WiCAN sends tester-present so the session stays open between steps. Released by obd_release() or when the script ends.

bindings.name: obd_release
bindings.doc: End the claimed conversation (automatic when the script ends).

bindings.name: obd_request
bindings.doc: Send a UDS request on the claimed connection and wait for the final answer (0x78 responsePending is handled). Sets uds_ok, uds_nrc and uds_pending.

bindings.name: obd_isotp_tx
bindings.doc: Send a raw ISO-TP payload on the claimed connection, no UDS handling.

bindings.name: obd_isotp_rx
bindings.doc: Receive one raw ISO-TP payload on the claimed connection (default 500 ms).

bindings.name: dtc_scan
bindings.doc: Run a trouble-code scan and wait for it (Trouble codes must be enabled). Parse the string with json.load(): valid, mil, stored, pending, permanent, freeze.

bindings.name: dtc_clear
bindings.doc: Clear trouble codes (needs Allow clearing). mode: 'always', 'if_any' or 'if_only'; codes: a comma list for a per-code UDS clear, '' for all.

bindings.name: dtc_desc
bindings.doc: Look a code up in the uploaded code databases.

bindings.name: can_tx
bindings.doc: Put one raw CAN frame on the WiCAN's own CAN controller (up to 8 data bytes; ext = 1 for a 29-bit id). Needs the CAN bus setting on; false when it is off or nobody acknowledged. No raw receive: answers come back through uds() or obd_isotp_rx().

bindings.name: emit
bindings.doc: Publish an event for the rules engine. The convention is emit('script', 'done', 'value', text): rules select on script.done and read ${value}.

bindings.name: obd_file_size
bindings.doc: Size of a file on the SD card ('/sd/...' paths only).

bindings.name: obd_file_read
bindings.doc: Read up to 512 bytes of an SD-card file as hex.

bindings.name: obd_transfer_file
bindings.doc: Stream an SD-card file to the ECU as TransferData (0x36) blocks and set uds_xfer_crc / uds_xfer_blocks. Needs Allow ECU flashing.

globals.name: uds_ok
globals.doc: 1 when the last uds() / uds_ext() / obd_request() got an answer (positive or negative), 0 when nothing answered.

globals.name: uds_nrc
globals.doc: The negative response code of that answer, or -1 when it was positive.

globals.name: uds_pending
globals.doc: How many 0x78 responsePending replies the last obd_request() waited through.

globals.name: uds_xfer_crc
globals.doc: CRC-32 of the data the last obd_transfer_file() sent.

globals.name: evt_source
globals.doc: Source of the event that triggered this run ('' when run by hand).

globals.name: evt_name
globals.doc: Name of that event, e.g. 'bit' for status.bit.

globals.name: evt_<field>
globals.doc: One global per field of the trigger event: evt_bit and evt_set for status.bit, evt_param / evt_value / evt_unit for autopid.param, evt_edge / evt_volts for battery.threshold, evt_timer for timer.tick.

primer.title: Comments
primer.code:
# to the end of the line
#- a block
   comment -#

primer.title: Text
primer.note: Only strings join with +; wrap numbers in str().

primer.title: Numbers
primer.note: Two integers divide to an integer.

primer.title: Conditions
primer.code:
if rpm > 3000
  log('high')
elif rpm > 0
  log('running')
else
  log('off')
end
ok = a && b || !c
primer.note: Every block ends with end; nil is false.

primer.title: Loops
primer.code:
for i : 0..4  log(str(i))  end
for v : [1, 2, 3]  ...  end
while millis() < t1  ...  end
break   continue

primer.title: Functions
primer.code:
def add(a, b)
  return a + b
end
var twice = def (x) return x * 2 end

primer.title: Lists & maps
primer.code:
var l = [1, 2]
l.push(3)  l[0]  size(l)
var m = {'rpm': 800}
m['speed'] = 0  m.find('x')  m.keys()
primer.note: find() returns nil when the key is missing; [] raises.

primer.title: Bytes & hex
primer.note: Responses are hex bytes separated by spaces.

primer.title: Modules
Errors
primer.code:
try
  risky()
except .. as e, m
  log(e + ': ' + m)
end
raise 'my_error', 'details'

errors.hint: Call obd_claim(tx, rx) before obd_request(), obd_isotp_tx() or obd_isotp_rx().
obd_claim() with other ids while a conversation is open: call obd_release() first.
Reprogramming services (0x34-0x37, obd_transfer_file) need Allow ECU flashing. Leave it off unless you are flashing an ECU.
The script ran past its budget: shorten loops and sleeps, or raise Max script runtime in the settings below.
Stopped with the Stop button or the console.
Every if / for / while / def / try block ends with end, strings are quoted, calls have parentheses. The line number is in the message.
Requests are hex bytes like '22 F1 90' (spaces optional, at most 8 for can_tx).
A name or method does not exist: check the spelling, and import string / json / math before using their functions.
A value has the wrong type: numbers need str() before + with text, and text needs int() or real() before arithmetic.
